annotation.title_clean: CASA 64/23 – Area Approval for Operation of RPA within 3 NM of Controlled Aerodromes using CASA-verified Drone Safety App – Canberra (YSCB), Adelaide (YPAD), Perth (YPPH) and Sydney (YSSY) Instrument 2023
annotation.title_en: CASA 64/23 – Area Approval for Operation of RPA within 3 NM of Controlled Aerodromes using CASA-verified Drone Safety App – Canberra (YSCB), Adelaide (YPAD), Perth (YPPH) and Sydney (YSSY) Instrument 2023
annotation.summary_en: Notifiable instrument made by CASA under the Civil Aviation Safety Regulations 1998, granting an area approval for operating remotely piloted aircraft (drones) within 3 nautical miles of controlled aerodromes at Canberra, Adelaide, Perth and Sydney using a CASA-verified drone safety app. Only title and metadata are shown.
key_provisions_or_claims: Area approval for RPA operations within 3 NM of controlled aerodromes
Applies to Canberra, Adelaide, Perth and Sydney airports
Operations must use a CASA-verified Drone Safety App
Made under the Civil Aviation Safety Regulations 1998
Registered 16 November 2023; effective 17 January 2024 per metadata
